status: FLAGGED — C1 CEILING BELOW FLOOR; C2/C8 TARGET COMPETENCE CONDITIONAL

c1_ceiling.proof: C1's denominator is the count of paired-control available rows across every target and non-target row in the stream. Target selection only partitions those rows; it cannot add available rows. The largest denominator any target selection can produce is therefore min(A_available, K_available) for the stream.

candidate_stream.conclusion: Every seed's maximum is below the 60-row floor. The current candidate stream is not C1-capable, even if every candidate is selected and every available row is retained. This is a branch-closing result for target selection on this stream.

cell_stream.conclusion: The 112-edge cell stream reaches 60 on four seeds but not on seeds 20630102 and 20630104. Switching to it does not make C1 attainable and changes the C4 stream to 108/92 non-target rows.

c1_ceiling.conclusion: The current registered design is not C1-capable under either reported stream. Target selection cannot repair the candidate stream; a new universe, a different seed block with better baseline availability, or a changed C1 estimator is required.
c1_ceiling.what_it_does_not_mean: This does not establish that A1 is impossible in principle. A different universe, seed block or C1 estimator could satisfy the floor. It establishes that the current stream and floor cannot be reconciled by selecting a different target block.

c2_c8_competence.status: CONDITIONAL — NOT A PROOF OF C2 OR C8 FAILURE
c2_c8_competence.assumption: This section treats baseline A and K availability as a precondition for a clean C2 row and a clean C8 double block. Under that target-competence reading, a row lacking baseline A or K cannot support all of C2's cells and cannot test a genuine A-K- double block.
c2_c8_competence.induction_caveat: C2 is a treatment gate, not a no-arm gate. The no-arm baseline cannot prove that a missing baseline path remains missing under A- or K+ treatment. If the unblocked arm can induce the absent path, exact C2 remains unmeasured. The counts are a conditional target-selection incompatibility, not a proof that C2 or C8 must fail.
c2_c8_competence.relationship: A1-TARGET-VIABILITY-1 reports carrier-missing exposure under the same baseline A/K reading. This report makes that reading explicit and does not treat it as proof of treatment failure.
c2_c8_competence.conclusion: Under the stated competence reading, N4 has at most 3 clean rows per seed for a 4-row block and N20 has at most 12 for a 20-row block. Neither current target set supplies a clean C8 block. Exact C2/C8 adjudication still requires cells or a pre-registered competence filter; the current data do not prove treatment failure.

disposition: Do not freeze or run the current A1 design on these records. C1 is not target-selectable, and target competence requires an owner rule. A1 must be redesigned with a C1-capable universe or seed block and a pre-registered competence rule, or parked. No cell, target freeze, grant or threshold change is authorised.
not_evidence: A read-only design-viability report over committed no-arm artifacts. It runs no A1 cell, freezes no target, changes no threshold and measures no treatment effect. The C2/C8 section is conditional on baseline target competence, not a C2 or C8 verdict.
